summary: GeoLunatics is an interactive space-learning project that transforms the exploration of the Moon and Mars into an exciting adventure for children. Through Xplora, players experience the journey of becoming astronauts, travelling to other worlds and discovering their unique environments. The project addresses the challenge of making planetary science understandable and engaging by connecting real lunar and Martian landscapes with similar places on Earth. Through interactive Earth analogue quizzes, scientific comparisons and exploration activities, players discover geological similarities, environmental differences and the precautions needed for space exploration. By combining creativity, storytelling and science-based learning, GeoLunatics encourages curiosity, critical thinking and a deeper understanding of our neighbouring worlds, inspiring the next generation of space explorers.
details:
Xplora: An Interactive Space Exploration Adventure

Xplora is an animated, story-based educational game that takes children on an exciting journey to explore the Moon and Mars. Players become astronauts by creating their characters, assembling a specialist crew, selecting a spacecraft, preparing for launch, travelling to another world and exploring its surface.

The project's main innovation is its Earth Analogue Comparison feature. Players guess which location on Earth resembles their lunar or Martian landing site. They then compare both locations using geological and environmental evidence, including rock types, minerals, landforms, soil, temperature, gravity and surface conditions. The game also explains differences and connects discoveries to practical astronaut precautions.

Guided by NOVA, a friendly robot, players learn through interactive stories, quizzes, exploration activities, voice narration and scientific discoveries. At the end, they receive a personalised Mission Summary and Certificate of Visit with learning badges.

Xplora makes complex planetary science engaging and accessible for children while encouraging scientific curiosity, critical thinking and evidence-based reasoning. Its creative combination of storytelling, customisable characters, interactive learning and real-world scientific comparisons makes it different from traditional educational resources.

During development, we considered scientific accuracy, age-appropriate content, accessibility, engaging visuals, intuitive navigation and meaningful learning experiences. Our goal is to make planetary science feel like an adventure while helping young explorers understand how Earth can prepare us for exploring other worlds.
